blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The investigation into the Batangas crash that killed four Philippine Air Force (PAF) pilots will cover flight planning, pilot training, aircraft maintenance and command leadership, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said on Saturday. Teodoro said investigators would conduct a comprehensive review of the incident, emphasizing that standard accident investigation procedures must be […]...
